text: This organic green tea is absolutely fantastic. The flavor is fresh and clean, with subtle grassy notes that aren't overpowering. I've been drinking it daily for the past 3 months and noticed improved energy levels without the jitters I get from coffee. The quality is noticeably better than Lipton or Twinings - you can actually see whole tea leaves instead of dust. A bit pricey at $15 per box, but totally worth it for the quality. Each bag can be steeped twice which makes it more economical. Highly recommend for anyone looking to switch from coffee or upgrade their tea selection.
